statement: Software tested; science exploratory; not certified; production not authorised. A passing test suite is not a certification.

repositories.role: changed by this work (base commit shown)

gates.title: Repository heads, dependencies and tests frozen before any change
gates.detail: All five heads equalled origin/main; spiderweb-pr was at the commit named in the proposal. 2109 core tests, 50 grid tests and 148 frontend tests passed before the change. main later advanced to b2c532f and was merged into the branch; one textual conflict in CHANGELOG.md. That work merged as pull request 458; the source-discovery work that followed started from main at 9c37b42.

gates.title: New registries cannot collide with existing meanings of ILAP and OSAP
gates.detail: Every legacy spelling classifies to its own namespace; bare acronyms are refused; no new identifier contains a reserved token; nothing existing was renamed.

gates.title: Owners agree on the canonical meaning of ILAP and the expansion of FIC/OSAP
gates.detail: Three questions for the repository owners are unanswered; the sibling repository claims a different canonical expansion.

gates.title: Full repository test suite
gates.detail: 2565 passed, 51 skipped, 0 failed; total coverage 76.68% against a floor of 62. 431 of the tests belong to the access-point package, 26 of them added with real-survey processing.

gates.title: Registry, ledger and certification schemas
gates.detail: 29 tests; committed documents conform; schema vocabularies are asserted equal to the code.

gates.title: Identity is never derived from name, distance, category or count
gates.detail: Correspondence cardinalities preserved; cross-namespace identity refused; identity binding needs an authoritative basis and an independent reviewer.

gates.title: Anomaly, feature, opening, passage and connection are kept apart
gates.detail: Shape alone cannot establish an opening; rungs cannot be skipped; contradictions are preserved; no automatic promotion; the producer cannot verify its own evidence.

gates.title: Missing CRS, unknown datum and wrong sign fail closed
gates.detail: Verified in software. No certified datum transform for Puerto Rico is registered, so no real land and sea surface can yet share a vertical axis. A stated datum is now also checked for regional plausibility: both processed tiles say NAVD88, which is not realised in Puerto Rico, so they are analysed singly and compared with each other but not joined to another reference.

gates.title: Positive and negative controls on synthetic surfaces
gates.detail: Planted shapes are found once at the planted place; planes, domes and noise yield nothing; two defects in the first implementation were found by these controls and fixed.

gates.title: Methods scored against independent field truth
gates.detail: No labelled truth set exists in the repository. No precision or recall is claimed for real terrain or seabed. Thresholds are uncalibrated defaults. Agreement between two surveys of the same ground was measured on real data; that shows a shape is not an artefact of one survey. It is not field truth, and no accuracy figure exists.

gates.title: A real terrain or bathymetric survey processed end to end
gates.detail: Two USGS 1 m elevation tiles (surveyed 2018-2019 and 2023-2025) were fetched under an explicit owner grant of two named files and 800 MB (716,183,858 bytes used), hashed, and processed over a 1 km window around the registered point of INAP-PR-000003. 17 and 19 closed basins were found; 13 of 17 are in both surveys; the surfaces differ by a median of 1 cm. The committed report is reproduced from committed evidence. Terrain only: no bathymetric survey has been processed. No record changed.

gates.title: Record counts close in every document and in the legacy crosswalk
gates.detail: 103 legacy nodes read: 5 matched, 81 without subtype, 17 unmatched, 0 without coordinates. The discovery catalogue closes: 180 sources listed, 3 registered inland and 177 off shore; all 47 surveys of the Guayama receipt were listed again and none is held twice. The survey report names 2 products and 2 are registered.

gates.title: Sources behind registry records are registered with exact bytes
gates.detail: The legacy node file and two elevation tiles are registered with the hash of their exact bytes; the tiles are held outside the repository. 180 survey sources are references only. The five seed screenshots are not attached.

gates.title: Annotated screenshots behind the five off-shore seeds are registered
gates.detail: No file, hash or control point has been supplied. The seeds remain provisional with no coordinates.

gates.title: Metadata discovery executed against live catalogues
gates.detail: Executed on 2026-11-16 under an explicit grant from the repository owner: 10 search boxes, 48 requests against a ceiling of 150, 48 provider runs of which 29 returned rows, 19 returned none and 0 failed; 180 distinct sources; 3150503 response bytes kept. Replaying the kept bytes offline reproduces every receipt and the catalogue. Metadata only: no data product was downloaded. Five of the search boxes are analyst corridors drawn from locality names; they are assumptions about where to look and give no seed a position.

gates.title: New read-only routes; no existing route changed
gates.detail: 51 tests; route inventory asserted; every method other than GET answers 405.

gates.title: Frontend lint, type check, unit and accessibility tests, production build
gates.detail: 183 tests (148 before); lint and type check clean; build succeeds.

gates.title: Workbench driven in a real browser against the live backend
gates.detail: Chromium: inland 4 drawn, off-shore 1 drawn, 5 records listed as having no coordinates, evidence view, synthetic banner on the control section, empty relationship ledger. One layout defect found and fixed.

gates.title: Existing six-module, three-browser runtime matrix
gates.detail: Passed in CI on pull request 458 at its final head 0d1b2a3 (workbench-matrix, frontend-ab, runtime-certification). Not run locally.

gates.title: Access-point layers in the 3D runtime
gates.detail: Not built. The 3D runtime has no data-layer contract, no terrain and no tests.

gates.title: Other producers' packages verified as context sources
gates.detail: aguayluz-pr: BLOCKED; moneysweep-pr: PASS; skywatcher-pr: PASS. moneysweep-pr yields 15 documentary records, none placeable.

gates.title: Access-point records exported to the hub
gates.detail: Not authorised and not implemented. The export script, its schemas and golden files are untouched.

gates.title: Measured runtime, memory and query latency
gates.detail: Measured on synthetic surfaces. Two measures regressed and are reported with the gains.

gates.title: Security assessment
gates.detail: Self-assessed only: read-only API, bounded parameters, no path built from input, documents verified on load, discovery denied by default. The backend has no authentication; no independent review.

gates.title: Rollback verified
gates.detail: The change is additive and confined to one branch; rollback is a revert. It has not been exercised.

gates.title: Qualified independent review
gates.detail: Not performed. This report was produced by the same process that produced the code and cannot stand in for it. The automated reviewer configured on the repository did not complete a review of pull request 458.

gates.title: Explicit authorisation to release
gates.detail: Not given. Nothing was deployed and no production data store was written.

gates.title: Continuous integration on the pull request
gates.detail: Pull requests 458 and 461 passed all their checks and were merged by the owner. The pull request carrying real-survey processing had not been opened when this report was written.

engineering.statement: Implemented and tested: 2565 tests pass with none failing. Not independently reviewed.

science.statement: Verified on synthetic controls and on one real window seen by two independent surveys. No field truth, thresholds uncalibrated, no bathymetric survey processed. Every registry record is a candidate or provisional; none is verified.

gui.statement: Unit, accessibility and one-browser checks pass locally; the three-browser matrix passed in CI. No 3D view.

federation.statement: Nothing is exported. One of three producer packages is absent. Hub-side registration is not started.

production.statement: No independent review and no authorisation.

scores.basis: Verified: registry, basin delineation, morphology and datum control are implemented, control-tested and run on real 1 m LiDAR elevation over one window, with two-survey replication; 4 candidate records. Missing: field validation, cave/mine/tunnel detectors, point-cloud handling, calibrated thresholds.

Verified: same core as inland plus seabed interpretation rules; a source denominator for the search box of every seed locality (177 reference sources); 6 records of which 5 are provisional with no coordinates. Missing: any processed survey, registered seed provenance, gridded-survey reading.

Verified: one processing core, datum contract, typed relationships, cross-sections and coastline versions, all tested; projected GeoTIFF reading and a regional plausibility check on stated datums added. Missing: certified datum transforms, reprojection, a spatial index.

Verified: default-deny metadata discovery executed live once and replayable offline; named-file product download inside a byte ceiling, executed once for two tiles. Missing: gridded bathymetric products, terrestrial sources beyond elevation, a second discovery run to exercise change detection on real data.
Verified: one real package read and closed; non-inference rules tested. Missing: an aguayluz-pr package, any export, hub registration.
Verified: software controls with known answers, and agreement between two independent surveys on real data (13 of 17 basins). Missing: any independent truth set, so no accuracy figure exists.
Verified: layer group, evidence view, relationship and cross-section explorers; 183 tests; three-browser matrix passed in CI. Missing: 3D, measured-surface display.

Verified: measured before and after; delineation, ingest and page queries faster; tiled processing bounds memory for local operators. Missing: tiling for basin filling (555 MB peak at 4 million cells), a spatial index.
Verified scores count only what was executed here. Projected scores assume the open gates listed in this report close as designed, with no new invention; they are estimates, not measurements.

service query: bounding-box page of 100 (median), 2,000 features
service query: evidence for one feature (median), 2,000 features
load and verify registry document, 2,000 features
